data: Verified actual committed-memory curriculum FIT six historical sequences and INNER0002; diagnostic0001 excluded from fitting and calibration.
supervision: Current exact committed UID correctness; verified-other and UNKNOWN are negative. H100 other-person and target-N10 risk use only actual complete matched WRITE/DENY pairs, with explicit missing-label mask.
current_feature_axis: Frozen32 opportunity features of actual committed UID, not original actor proposal UID; no GT or future features.
normalization: FIT-only sequence-equal mean/std, std floor0.05; current loss sequence-equal, balanced correctness classes.
selection: Earliest minimum INNER joint loss. No outer/confirmation/VAL/test selection. All three seeds retained.
calibration_gate: At the fixed runtime point: nonzero accepted observations, observed wrong-or-UNKNOWN <=2%, correct-write retention >=60% of currently correct committed observations; full candidate-available retention separately reported. At least one complete INNER pair must be selected, with zero observed paired future harm. Failure => explicit CALIBRATION_ABSTAIN; not population risk guarantee.
rollout_plan: Committed-only risk writer plus fixed/unsafe/frozen/delayed/diverse/rollback controls, capacities1/4/8 and mean/confidence/frozen existing attention aggregation. Shadow AA is engineering control only; actual coupled authority MOT pilot separately evaluated.
